title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED THREE HUNDRED AND EIGHT, BY PROVIDING THAT THE PRESIDENTS OF MUNICIPAL BOARDS OF HEALTH IN MUNICIPALITIES WHERE PROVINCIAL JAILS ARE LOCATED SHALL ACT AS PHYSICIANS TO PRISONERS CONFINED IN SUCH JAILS, UPON REQUEST OF PROVINCIAL BOARDS.

title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 308 bằng cách quy định Chủ tịch Hội đồng Y tế Thị xã tại các thị xã có nhà tù tỉnh sẽ đảm nhiệm vai trò bác sĩ cho các tù nhân bị giam giữ tại các nhà tù đó theo yêu cầu của Hội đồng Tỉnh
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่308โดยกำหนดให้ประธานคณะกรรมการสาธารณสุขเทศบาลในเทศบาลที่มีเรือนจำจังหวัดทำหน้าที่เป็นแพทย์ให้กับนักโทษที่ถูกคุมขังในเรือนจำดังกล่าวตามคำร้องขอของคณะกรรมการสาธารณสุขจังหวัด
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 308 dengan menetapkan bahwa Presiden Dewan Kesehatan Kota di kota-kota yang memiliki penjara provinsi bertindak sebagai dokter bagi tahanan yang ditahan di penjara tersebut atas permintaan Dewan Provinsi
title.ms: Akta Mengubah Akta Nombor 308 dengan menetapkan bahawa Pengerusi Jawatankuasa Kesihatan Perbandaran di perbandaran yang mempunyai penjara wilayah bertindak sebagai doktor kepada banduan yang ditahan di penjara tersebut atas permintaan Jawatankuasa Wilayah

text.en:
Act Numbered Three hundred and eight, entitled "An Act providing for the establishment of
municipal boards of health, and fixing their powers and duties," is hereby amended by adding at the close of
section six the following words: "Whenever a municipal board of health has been established in a
municipality where a provincial jail is located, the president of such municipal board of health shall act as
physician to the prisoners confined in the provincial jail, if required to do so by resolution of the provincial

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 20, 1902.
